rationale: S-0083-05 proposes a multi-seed smoke gate / robustness check across t0083's joint-pass cells to determine whether each cell reproduces under different RNG seeds. t0086 (robustness_cluster_bio_comparison, this brainstorm session's primary commission) covers this gate exactly in its Phase A: re-evaluate the top 20 cells (15 joint-pass cells from t0081+t0083 plus 5 closest near-pass cells from the t0083 Pareto front) at 24 directions x 30 seeds x 5 outer RNG-seed replications and classify each cell as Genuine (5/5 replications joint-pass), Marginal (3-4/5), or Stochastic (<=2/5). The 30-seed x 5-outer-rep budget is larger than S-0083-05's original scope and produces the cleaner three-way classification needed for downstream cluster analysis. Rejecting as covered by t0086.
